notes: The long barrel now reaches the reference proportion more closely, but the deterministic front comparison still has IoU 0.4997 with framing/aspect mismatch; stock and receiver remain too blocky.
Two seated collars, rail saddles, top fasteners and turret are readable from front/top; rings remain heavier and more primitive than the reference.
Recessed physical eyepiece/objective glass reads as reflective in orbit, but the objective face remains too dark/flat and the taper is still oversized.
Bolt is now receiver-parented and longer, with a usable bent grip below the scope; its broadside profile and shaft transition remain approximate.
Guard contacts the receiver/stock junction and the thumbhole remains open, but the guard is blocky and the trigger/guard placement is not yet reference-correct.
A true helix, hinge, lock, telescoping legs and feet are present; the helix is less crowded after reduction, but the folded assembly still needs closer reference fitting.
Front and orbit renders retain the real side-face artwork on the stock/receiver, but grazing views still show a weak seam/stretch at the thumbhole/receiver transition.
Crown-up/skull-down orientation and tangent attachment hold in top/orbit views; foil detail remains simplified and compresses at grazing angles.
